theme: Last day ashore before the charter.
greeting: Your final full day in Dubrovnik before Saturday's charter, Dan. The calendar's clear, but a short list of before-you-board errands wants clearing while you're still on dry land and connected.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat logistics before you board
needsAttention.detail: Three things in Todoist need doing from dry land before Saturday: the Komolac to Cavtat transfer on the 19th, a bag-hold at the Remisens for the noon-to-3PM gap, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout plus airport taxi. Charter signal is poor once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the boarding time and return transfer
needsAttention.detail: Reach the Nautilus instructor to nail down exactly when and where you board tomorrow, and arrange the Sept 19 airport transfer now, while you still have bandwidth and signal.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 rental outright
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge in Todoist: the Pathfinder can't reach Florida before Oct 18, so this cycle needs the rental. Full-size SUV at TPA to meet your 3:55 PM Sunday landing, so you don't arrive car-less and jet-lagged.

needsAttention.title: Close the St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete stay was pending host confirmation, per Todoist. Verify it converted rather than expired, and the Sept 20-21 gap before the Tuesday kid pickup still needs a place to stay.

flagged.title: Nautilus sent a trip send-off
flagged.detail: Amy at Nautilus Sailing wished you and Mike a good week and flagged good weather. No reply needed.

flagged.title: ICGN conference in Toronto, November
flagged.detail: ICGN's Autumn Conference booking is open. Worth a glance for governance networking while the board search is live.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and travel marketing (Expedia, Booking, VRBO, Chairish, HBO Max) plus food and finance newsletters.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Pre-boarding provisioning in Dubrovnik: cash, snacks, alcohol, dietary items

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar. The last open morning in Dubrovnik is entirely yours.
Shore errands cluster here: provisioning, cash, and confirming Saturday's boarding and the Cavtat transfers while you still have signal.
A last night in the old town before you board the charter tomorrow at five.
